name: How much does it cost to hire a brain trauma lawyer?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a brain trauma lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most brain trauma lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you won't pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's fee is a percentage of the compensation they recover for you, typically around 33% to 40%. If they don't win your case, you generally don't owe attorney's fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without immediate financial burden.
